## Rule Cheat Sheet

- **Aliases — collect every variant**: Gather ALL name forms per entity into `aliases[]`, including non-Latin scripts (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, etc.). If the source contains a Chinese name for an entity, that name MUST appear in `aliases[]` — not only in description or free-text fields.
- **No orphan aliases**: Every alias must attach to an entity record; never emit standalone alias strings.
- **Deduplicate by entity id**: When the same entity appears multiple times, merge into one record and union all alias sets.
- **Relations reference existing ids**: `src` and `dst` in every relation must match an entity `id` already present in the pack.
- **Stages are sequential**: Multi-stage content splits into `stages[]` with ascending integer `order` values starting at 0.
- **Provenance required**: Each extracted entity and relation carries a `provenance` pointer to its source component.
- **Confidence scored**: Assign `confidence` (0–1) to every extracted item; items below 0.5 need a provenance note explaining uncertainty.
